# GRYOnline — The Escape

- Original source: [GRYOnline — The Escape](https://www.gry-online.pl/poradniki/robin-hood-legenda-sherwood/ucieczka/z2f57)
- Author / publication: GRYOnline.pl
- Language / date: Polish; displayed update 2019-09-02
- Access: Full chapter retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: none found in the Wayback Machine (checked 2026-09-09)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then a complete English rendering of the route as factual notes (site forbids copying its text)

The opening of this chapter describes Marian and companions rescuing the captured Robin. It recommends John and Stuteley, with Will useful against knights.

The initial approach uses John to draw guards toward the bridge, knock them out, and have them bound. A nearby knight harassing civilians is approached from behind before the party deals with road patrols. This is evidence of a deliberate nonlethal route built around complementary party abilities.

**Coverage limit:** only the retrieved opening was inspected; the remaining rescue route and completion conditions are not summarized here. Follow the original for its map and full sequence.

## Detailed notes (full chapter, in English)

Chapter "Ucieczka" (The Escape) of the GRYOnline.pl walkthrough; the page shows a release date of 12 November 2002 for the game and a site-wide notice forbidding copying of its text, so the Polish text is not transcribed. Bracketed numbers are the guide's map markers.

**Setup.** Robin was captured on his last expedition; Marian and friends must free him. The guide says John and Stuteley are standard picks and Will Scarlet is useful against knights.

**Outside the walls.**
1. Stand on the small bridge so the guard patrolling the crossroads sees Little John. Two men run over: knock out and tie.
2. Right of the bridge, by a hut, a knight is abusing a peasant couple. John takes him from behind.
3. Deal with the sergeant, archer and guard patrolling the road in front of the house, then the soldiers at the bridge in the lower-right corner (approached properly, no staff fight is needed).
4. Group at the mill [1]: knock out the archers first; tie everyone.
5. Cross the wooden bridge by the mill. A knight patrols the road by a hut: John from behind, tie, hide in the hut.
6. Go left to the stocks in the left part of the map. Knock out the sleeping guard, then fight the group at the large prison tower [2] with the staff, archers first.
7. Inside the tower knock out the guards. A peasant sits in the cell; entering the cell triggers a black knight, whom Will handles best. The peasant reveals where the sheriff holds Robin [3].

**Entrance gate [4].**
- Little John steps into the view of the gate guards and sergeant to draw them into attacking. If a wall soldier notices, wait for him and deal with him. A courtyard soldier will notice the sergeant is missing and run to the gate: disable him.
- Pay the beggar and collect all hints outside the Nottingham walls.
- John sneaks to the soldier sleeping against the hut by the castle ramp, climbs the stairs left of the hut onto the walls, knocks out another sleeper, then works along the walls toward the gate [4] knocking out everyone. Stuteley follows the same way and ties them all.

**Garden and square.**
- Next to the stairs leading from the walls above the gate is a garden with four crossbowmen, several soldiers and a sergeant. A quick action with John: run into the soldiers, spin attack, move to the crossbowmen, spin again; finish the rest and tie with Stuteley.
- On the square [5] with the stocks, attack the crossbowman and soldier standing together, knock out the sleeping guard beside them, tie and hide them, free the peasant in the stocks.
- Knock out the archer by the castle ramp, then attack the group guarding the main gate [6] in front of the ramp. One raises the alarm; ignore it and knock everyone out. A sizeable group of crossbowmen and soldiers arrives: run in and spin several times, then tie the whole lot.

**Inside.**
- Little John gives Will a leg up onto the walls at the spot known from the archery tournament. Will clears every enemy on the walls.
- Go right to Robin's cell [3] and free him, then clear the courtyard in front of the castle.
- Before leaving the walls, take the door left of the main entrance onto the balcony and remove the sergeant, then go up to Prince John's chamber [7], which holds the royal seal guarded by a knight (Will has no trouble).
- Robin and Will jump back over the wall. Knock out the soldier talking to children under the cathedral, give alms to the beggar, follow his hints to learn who betrayed Robin, take the money from the traitor and return to Sherwood.

**Reader comments on the page** (2004–2010) include a cheat list: with the character standing, hover the mouse over the kneel icon (do not click it) and press F11 for a console; codes GOODLUCK (clover), CASH (money), BINGO (999 ammunition), IMMUNITY (invulnerable), MERRYMAN (one recruit), TIMELESS (stops time), PAM (enemies fight stupidly), UNBLIP (show everyone on the map), WINNER (win the mission). Other comments complain about repetitive missions and ask how to enter the prince's building in the Derby mission.
